about.p1: Senior Software Engineer with <1>13+ years</1> of experience designing, modernizing, and scaling business-critical systems for fintechs, marketplaces, loyalty platforms, logistics, and healthtech companies.
about.p2: Strong expertise in backend architecture, legacy modernization, microservices, cloud environments, and enterprise integrations. Proven track record working on high-traffic applications and scalable SaaS platforms focused on performance, maintainability, and long-term reliability.
